title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: Adding Employee Cards to Your Account
summary: This document explains how to add and manage employee cards for the Business Bronze Rewards Card under a business account, including issuing up to 7 employee cards. It covers the add-card steps (legal name, email, mailing address; role-based permissions and spend controls; request submission and activation tracking) and ongoing management (spend controls/merchant categories/alerts, locking/canceling on employee departure, and reviewing transactions).
faqs: How many employee cards can I add to my Business Bronze Rewards Card business account?
What information do I need to submit when adding an employee card (name, email, address)?
How do I assign permissions and set spend controls for each employee card?
After submitting an employee card request, how can I track its activation status?
Can I change spending controls, merchant category permissions, and alerts after cards are issued?
What should I do if an employee leaves—can I lock or cancel their card and reassign budget?
keywords: Lock or cancel on employee departure
